localization.source_quote: 한우 수소는 대부분이 생후 약 30개월령(거세우 기준)에 시장에 출하된다.
localization.scope: Illustrative Daegwallyeong/Hanwoo pasture and Korean delivery-map localization, not traced suppliers; example paths follow the OpenStreetMap road network. No claim of pasture-only feeding for the full 30 months. Opening/closing totals agree with the approximate age. Other time labels retain source values; the map scale is recomputed in kilometres.

map.route_scope: OSRM road-network example routes from illustrative origins. Daegwallyeong route uses 영동고속도로 and 광주원주고속도로 plus connecting roads; not a supplier route.

wheat.scope: Illustrative Korean wheat field, not an actual supplier
wheat.source_quote: 전북 부안군우리밀 ... 전남 나비골월송영농조합 ... 제빵에 적합한 백강 단일품종
wheat.regional_area_quote: 2023년 전국 11,600ha; 전북 4,618ha, 전남 4,572ha, 광주 1,133ha. Historical evidence of regional concentration, not a current-year statistic.

visual_context.approval: Owner requested Korean map relief, removal of the sun/palm trees, a Korean burger shop and vehicles, and Korean-looking farmers/shopkeepers.
visual_context.map_relief: Stylized connected Taebaek/Sobaek ridge meshes, not measured elevation. The sun was present in the original day map but is intentionally removed.
visual_context.shop: Seoul neighborhood storefront with the original English BURGERS sign, retained by owner request; no palm trees or American diner decor.
visual_context.compass_and_island: Small N arrow retained after confirming it appears in the original map. The eastern Natural Earth island polygon is Ulleungdo and is now labelled 울릉도.
visual_context.harvest_workers: Two spaced Korean workers in the hand-harvest shot, reduced from seven at the owner's request.
visual_context.vehicles: Ordinary Korean-style cab-over 1-ton grain truck and compact hatchbacks; red agricultural tractor. No brand logos.
visual_context.people: Natural black/dark hair and practical Korean farm/shop workwear, without exaggerated facial features.

captions.subtitle: 점심에 먹기까지, 시간을 거슬러
captions.context: Time markers count backwards from the finished burger at lunchtime; stated once, not repeated in each marker.

captions.text:
전라도의 우리밀 밭에
번을 만들 밀을 심습니다.

벌이 없으면 피클도,
피클이 없으면 소스도 없어요.

그 누구도 혼자서는
만들 수 없었습니다.

shots.subject: The exact assembled double cheeseburger on its folded white paper: plain golden top bun without sesame, cheese over beef, onion ring, second cheese over beef, lettuce, tomato, pink spread and bottom bun. No plate or board.

The exact exploded vertical burger diagram, with its layers at the exact heights in this input: bun, beef and cheese, onion, beef and cheese, lettuce, tomato, pink spread, bottom bun. Preserve both patties and both cheese slices; no extra food.

The exact mother cow and newborn calf at their source positions and poses. ONE OWNER-APPROVED LOCALIZATION: replace white-faced Hereford markings with plain warm tawny-brown Hanwoo cattle (including brown faces, no white patches), and the distant hills with lush green rolling mountain pasture of Daegwallyeong, Korea. Keep the tree at right, fence, flowers, blue sky, camera and animal counts unchanged. Preserve the calf's precise lying or standing pose; never add an extra calf.

The same mother cow and calf, preserving their exact source positions, proportions, head directions and standing poses. ONE OWNER-APPROVED LOCALIZATION: all cattle are plain warm tawny-brown Korean Hanwoo with brown faces, no white markings; distant hills become lush green Daegwallyeong mountain pasture. Keep the exact tree, fence, flowers, sky and animal count. No extra animals.

The exact grazing cow and only those background cows actually visible in this source frame, at their precise source positions. ONE OWNER-APPROVED LOCALIZATION: replace Hereford markings with plain warm tawny-brown Korean Hanwoo (brown faces, no white patches), and all golden distant hills with lush green Daegwallyeong mountain pasture. Keep the existing tree, fence, flowers, framing, animal counts and the source's current sun, rain and clouds. No new landmarks or objects.

The exact side-view red tractor and driver sowing a vast brown furrowed field with the same growing green rows, distant green tree line, blue sky and clouds. Preserve the tractor's orientation, wheels and exact horizontal position. Owner-approved illustrative Jeolla Korean wheat field (우리밀), supported by MAFRA examples.

The exact four-stage dairy diagram, preserving ONLY the stages already visible in this input: black-and-white dairy cow and milk can at upper left, milk vat at upper right, curd vat at lower left and cheddar block on a table at lower right, with the same red flow arrows. Do not prematurely add any still-absent stages.

The same close-up green cucumber vine with leaves and one yellow flower, and the bee in exactly its current position if present. Preserve the flower's size, the vine curves and the flat cream negative space.

The exact same cucumber vine and stage shown: yellow flower or green cucumber, bee if visible, and pickle slices and spread jar only when already present. Preserve all red arrows, layout and transformation stage; do not add later stages early.

The exact red combine harvester in a golden wheat field, the white grain truck below its unloading pipe, the small sun and distant hills, plus the small flour mill inset at bottom right only if present. Retain every machine and its position. Owner-approved illustrative Jeolla Korean wheat field (우리밀), supported by MAFRA examples.

The exact industrial meat-grinder diagram and patty press: silver hopper at left feeding red ground beef onto the black conveyor, round press at right and raw patties at their current positions. Keep the entire machine layout and current action.

The exact wide view of farm workers hand-harvesting lettuce and tomatoes, with the harvesting conveyor tractor at left, people across the middle and the same green crop rows, sunset sky, mountains and sun. Preserve the number and positions of all people.

The exact dark pre-dawn bakery scene: clock on dark brown wall at left, wooden table with flour sack below and tray of buns, silver oven at right with its actual door and tray state. Preserve whether buns are pale rising dough or baked golden, and the tray's actual position. Keep the dark background dark, including the blank header.

Owner-approved Korean clay map on a navy night background: one fixed Natural Earth terrain sculpt, Daegwallyeong pasture and Seoul destination, native Korean ingredient labels, illustrative coloured routes and rigid truck glyphs. Legacy anchors are archived, not rendered.

The same fixed Korean delivery map across the diagonal night/day reveal, with rigid trucks and native Korean labels. No geography morphing or regenerated terrain; legacy California anchors are archived, not rendered.

The same fixed Korean delivery map in daylight. Complete the dawn reveal and delivery to Seoul without deforming the terrain or truck glyphs. All paths are illustrative and labelled as examples; legacy California anchors are archived, not rendered.

The exact top-down wooden cutting board on a silver countertop: red tomato halves and slices, purple onion and onion ring, green lettuce and separated leaves, and the horizontal knife near the bottom, in the exact current slicing state. Preserve the overhead view and every object's position.

The exact front/overhead griddle shot: two beef patties at their current flipping, raw or browned stage, dark rectangular steel cooking surface, silver backsplash, same rows of blue/orange gas flames and black burner knobs below. No buns or cheese before they appear in the source.

The exact same griddle with two beef patties, melting yellow cheese and two plain bun halves in their current airborne or resting positions. Preserve their exact positions and cooking stages, flames, knobs, griddle and backsplash. No sesame or extra ingredients.

The exact burger assembly on white folded paper, preserving each incoming ingredient's current position and order: bottom bun and spread, tomato, lettuce, first cheese-topped patty, onion, second cheese-topped patty, plain top bun. Do not complete the burger early or add a plate; retain airborne ingredients if shown.

The exact California roadside burger drive-in, with the same teal and cream low building, red rectangular rooftop sign, palm tree at right, server in white at the car window, teal convertible and any second red car at their current positions. Keep the car motion and character count; no redesigned storefront or added props.

The exact growing lineup of workers, preserving ONLY the people already visible and their exact positions and clothes: rancher with cowboy hat and rope, red plaid farmer with wheat, green dairy farmer with pail, blue-shirt picker with lettuce, white-hat baker with tray, plaid-shirt red-cap driver, white-apron cook with spatula. Keep the bee in its current position only if shown. Do not add any missing person early.

The exact seven-person lineup and hovering bee, with each worker's clothes, tools, skin tone, pose and position preserved. Left to right: rancher with cowboy hat and rope, farmer with wheat, dairy farmer with pail, picker with lettuce, baker with buns, driver with keys, cook with spatula. Rounded friendly handmade clay figures, no extra characters.

The exact final double cheeseburger on folded white paper, preserving whether the right-side bite is already present and its precise shape. Two beef patties and two melted cheese slices with onion between, lettuce, tomato, spread and plain bun. Keep crumbs and steam only where shown; no sesame, no plate and no different camera framing.
